parts.latex:
The scale of a map is 1 : 12500.

If the actual distance between two points is 650 m, what is the distance between these points on the map?

Chris purchased a laptop for \$2 999.00 exactly 3 years ago.

He claims 15% depreciation per year using the declining balance method.

Calculate the current salvage value of the laptop.
Which of the following expresses $V$ as the subject of the formula $u=\dfrac{\sqrt{mV}}{2}$ ?

Adam purchased some office furniture five years ago. It depreciated by \$2300 each year based on the straight-line method of depreciation. The salvage value of the furniture is now \$7500.

Find the initial value of the office furniture.
Solve: $x+\dfrac{x-1}{2}=9$

A formula for the dosage in mL ($D$) of medicine required for a child aged between 1 and 12 years compared to an adult's dosage ($A$) is:

$$D=\dfrac{yA}{y+12}$$

where $y$ is the age of the child (years).

A 6-year-old child is to take 5 mL of a prescribed medicine three times per day.

What is the equivalent daily adult dosage of this medicine?

Sydney is 10 hours ahead of Coordinated Universal Time (UTC + 10) and New York is 5 hours behind Coordinated Universal Time (UTC $-5$).

Tony travels from Sydney to New York. His plane leaves Sydney at 8:20 pm on Wednesday local time and flies non-stop to New York.

The flight takes 20 hours and 24 minutes.

What time and day is it in New York when the plane lands?

solutions.latex:
Scale is $1\text{ cm}=125\text{ m}$.

$$\text{map distance}=\dfrac{\text{actual distance}}{\text{scale}}=\dfrac{650}{125}=5.2\text{ cm}$$ Answer (D).

solutions.marks_breakdown: 2: provides correct solution; 1: correct substitution into $S=V_0-Dn$ or equivalent merit
2: provides correct solution; 1: writes fraction using a common denominator, or equivalent merit

solutions.latex:
Time difference $=10-(-5)=15$ hours.

8:20 pm on Wednesday (Sydney) plus 20 hours 24 minutes $=$ 4:44 pm Thursday (Sydney).

4:44 pm $-$ 15 hours $=$ 1:44 am New York.

In New York it will be 1:44 am Thursday.
solutions.marks_breakdown: 3: provides correct solution; 2: finds the time in Sydney when the plane lands in New York, or equivalent merit; 1: finds the time difference between Sydney and New York, or equivalent merit

solutions.latex:
Radius $=3$ cm, cylinder length $=18-6=12$ cm.

Volume of capsule $=$ volume of sphere $+$ volume of cylinder

$$V=\dfrac{4}{3}\pi r^3+\pi r^2 h=\dfrac{4}{3}\pi\times 3^3+\pi\times 3^2\times 12=542.389$$

Volume of water $=\dfrac{1}{3}\times 542.389=150.796=150.80\text{ cm}^3$
solutions.marks_breakdown: 3: provides correct solution; 2: provides correct volume of capsule; 1: identified radius and cylinder length
